body: ## What changed Add `Var.deep_equals()` for structural frontend comparisons. It compiles to the single-purpose `lodash.isequal` package, so nested objects and arrays compare by value rather than JavaScript identity. This covers the data-driven form use case in #7160, including object key order and nested mappings. ## Testing - `uv run pytest -q tests/units/test_var.py` (239 passed) - `uv run pytest -q tests/integration/tests_playwright/test_cond_match.py` in dev and production: nested and reordered objects, arrays, nulls, type boundaries, reactive form edits and saves, and existing conditional rendering. - full unit suite in independent QA (9643 passed) - Ruff, Pyright, ty, and `make_pyi` in independent QA - differential Node checks against `lodash.isEqual` for objects, collections, typed values, sparse arrays, symbols, and cyclic graphs The package is pinned to `lodash.isequal@4.5.0`. npm marks that package deprecated in favor of Node's `util.isDeepStrictEqual`, but its behavior matches the lodash-style semantics requested here and avoids adding all of lodash.
title: Add deep equality for frontend Vars
